change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: Use stock T3 native dispatch and the shared local Paseo fallback with the same persisted workflow.
change_reconciliation.authority: The user explicitly requested both dispatch paths, route renewal, and an Agent Sync push.
change_reconciliation.checks: The focused dispatcher, workflow and route regression suites and two live dependent-task probes.

outcome_review.expected: A scoped native worker result can advance a persisted dependency on either dispatcher.
outcome_review.observed: Stock T3 dispatched a Codex worker and Paseo dispatched an OMP worker. Each workflow validated the terminal handle and passed its exact output into a dependent task. Offline checks covered route renewal, duplicate launch rejection and dependency result binding.
outcome_review.limitations: Checks cover small tool-free text tasks. The installation reported its T3 OMP child unavailable. These runtime checks do not constitute comparative shared instruction measurements.

instruction_changes.deviation: The shared workflow instructions contained no path to apply T3 or Paseo worker handles to saved tasks.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: The existing shared workflow owner guides controllers through native or fallback dispatch, expiry and resume.
instruction_changes.alternative: Pairwise agent integrations would duplicate worker selection and lifecycle, and a T3 patch would require update maintenance.
